West Africa deepwater explorer

Reading the seabed before the rest of the margin does.

BluEnergies is advancing frontier deepwater exploration in West Africa's Harper Basin, identifying Cretaceous fan systems alongside operating partner TotalEnergies through high-resolution 3D seismic reprocessing and multibeam seabed surveys.

Who we are

A focused explorer, not a portfolio of everything.

High success rates in basin floor fan plays from Ghana to Namibia to Côte d'Ivoire have pulled the industry toward Africa's Atlantic margin. We got into the Harper Basin early, and we keep our work narrow so every dollar goes into understanding one place well.

2020
Company founded with a focused deepwater exploration mandate.
3
Offshore exploration blocks: LB-26, LB-30, and LB-31 in the Harper Basin.
7
Cretaceous basin floor fan systems mapped on regional 3D seismic.
Assets & operations

Harper Basin, offshore Liberia.

Seismic reprocessing and seabed surveys are under way with TotalEnergies to firm up drillable prospects and, later, well locations.

Reconnaissance Licence RL-003 covers 8,924 km² across three contiguous ultra-deepwater blocks. The work programme leverages high-resolution 3D reprocessing alongside multibeam bathymetric coring to map stratigraphic trapping and direct hydrocarbon indicators across the transform margin.

Explore the asset

Who holds what

Reconnaissance licence RL-003. Expenditure under the licence is recoverable upon transition to production sharing contracts.
